About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 


THE ROLE

We are looking for full stack engineers to build fast across BJAK's AI Finance Agent.

This role is for product-minded engineers who can move across frontend, backend, internal tools and customer journeys to turn ideas into working products quickly.

 


WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 - Build customer-facing and internal product features end to end.

 - Develop web flows, backend APIs, admin tools, dashboards and operational systems.

 - Support products across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel and financial services.

 - Work with product, design, mobile and operations teams to launch fast.

 - Integrate APIs, handle data flows and improve production reliability.

 - Use analytics, feedback and production issues to improve features after launch.

 - Help build tools that reduce manual work and improve speed across the business.

 


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 3+ years of full stack software engineering experience.

 - Strong frontend and backend fundamentals.

 - Experience with modern web frameworks, APIs, databases and production systems.

 - Able to build useful products quickly without needing perfect specs.

 - Good product sense, UX awareness and attention to detail.

 - Comfortable debugging across the stack.

 - Experience in fintech, insurtech, marketplace, consumer apps or high-volume platforms is a strong advantage.

 


THE KIND OF BUILDER WE WANT

 - Can turn rough requirements into working product.

 - Thinks about user flow, backend logic and business process together.

 - Moves fast while keeping systems maintainable.

 - Takes ownership from build to launch to post-launch fixes.

 - Clear about what they personally built and what was team-owned.

 


THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR

 - Engineers who only want to work on one narrow layer.

 - People who need complete specs before starting.

 - Developers who ship UI without understanding backend or operations impact.

 - Candidates who avoid production support.

 - People who make vague claims without showing real shipped work.

 


LOCATION

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in United States. We are hiring for this market specifically, so applicants should already be based in United States.

 


LANGUAGE

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 


INTERVIEW PROCESS

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Technical interview

3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

ABOUT GREENBOARD

At Greenboard, we're building the future of financial compliance. Greenboard is the unified, AI-native compliance operating system for RIAs, fintechs, private funds, hedge funds, and more. It replaces the fragmented mix of legacy tools and automates more than previously possible. By centralizing data and workflows, Greenboard helps firms reduce regulatory risk, simplify their technology stack, modernize how they run compliance, and save money.

Our founding team includes engineers who have scaled products at Amazon, Google, and multiple unicorn startups. We're backed by Y Combinator, General Catalyst, Base10, and other top-tier investors, and have raised over $20M to date. Brand-name financial institutions already rely on Greenboard, and we're growing fast.

ABOUT THE ROLE

You'll join the engineering team full-time in Summer 2027 and start shipping to production in your first weeks. The problems are real ones: building AI agents to detect insider trading, scaling message archiving systems that handle tens of millions of messages per day, and designing the data infrastructure underneath both.

This is not a rotational program and there is no training track. You'll own features end to end, talk to customers about what you're building, and get direct feedback from engineers who have scaled products at Amazon, Google, and multiple unicorn startups. Early engineers here have a real say in how the product gets built.

WHO ARE YOU?

 - Love to move fast and build things

 - Looking for deep ownership over the products you build

 - Obsess over the customers you're building for

 - An excellent communicator

 - Value collaboration

 - Located in NYC, or planning to be by your start date

QUALIFICATIONS

 - Graduating with a BS or MS in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field between December 2026 and Spring 2027

 - Strong programming skills in Node JS and Python, built through internships, personal projects, or research

 - Exposure to cloud infrastructure, ideally AWS

 - Coursework, projects, or internship work involving AI and machine learning

 - Evidence you can build and ship something on your own, whether that's an internship project, an open source contribution, or something you made because you wanted it to exist

 - Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced startup environment

 - Interest in the financial industry is a plus, but not necessary

BENEFITS

 - 401(k) with 5% company match

 - Medical, dental, and vision coverage

 - 15 days PTO + 11 company holidays + flexible sick time

 - 2 additional PTO days for each year of service (up to 10 additional days)

 - 10 remote days per year plus additional around the holidays

 - Bi-annual off-sites and team retreats

 - Front-row seat to building the operating backbone of modern finance
